name: IL-6 Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of IL-6 using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of interleukin 6 (IL-6) in human serum, plasma, whole blood and fingertip blood samples. IL-6 is an early marker in acute inflammation and this test can be used as an aid in the inflammatory diseases. For professional and laboratory use.
